subject: Mobile Development
title: The US DOJ Sues Apple
description: A quick, practical guide to The US DOJ Sues Apple.

hook.text: In March 2024, the US Department of Justice filed an antitrust lawsuit against Apple.

buildup.text: The DOJ alleged Apple illegally maintains a smartphone monopoly through restrictive practices.

discovery.text: The complaint cited blocked super apps, restricted messaging, and limited payment options.

twist.text: This is the biggest US government tech antitrust case since Microsoft in the 1990s.

climax.text: The lawsuit could fundamentally reshape how Apple controls the iPhone ecosystem.

punchline.text: The US government called the iPhone a monopoly.

quiz.question: What did the US DOJ allege in its 2024 lawsuit?
options: Apple illegally maintains a smartphone monopoly
